## Checklist

- [ ] Behavioral changes have a regression test that failed before the implementation.
- [ ] Android remains usable without a backend connection.
- [ ] Simulated and conceptual capabilities remain clearly labelled.
- [ ] No secrets, personal addresses, or user data are included.
- [ ] Relevant focused and full checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.
